giver.name: English Braille / Unified English Braille grade-1 (uncontracted) cells, indicators and punctuation
giver.cell_identity_giver: Unicode Character Database names BRAILLE PATTERN DOTS-xxxx (python unicodedata)
giver.licence_note: en.wikipedia tables CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution in PROVENANCE.md); cites BANA EBAE 2002 / ICEB UEB 2013

disagreements: parentheses (oracle is EBAE one-cell, giver UEB two-cell)

rule: priors REFUSE or NOMINATE, never admit: a unit absent from the table is a typed gap, never a guess

rules.numeric_mode: numeric indicator opens numeric mode; letter cells a-j read as digits 1-9,0; ',' and '.' continue it only when a digit cell follows; any other cell or a space ends it
rules.grade1_letter_after_number: a letter a-j directly after a number needs the grade-1 letter indicator
rules.capital: one capital indicator before the letter; two before a word of >=2 letters that is all capitals
rules.scope: grade-1 (uncontracted) text; contractions, formatting indicators beyond capitals/numeric, Nemeth, music and IPA braille are NOT in this prior (typed gaps)
